```{r}
heat = expr[rownames(expr) %in% byers_genes,]
heat_scaled = t(scale(t(heat)))
```


```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
Heatmap(heat_scaled)
```


```{r}
library(pheatmap)
library(matrixStats)
# Scale by row
mat_scaled <- t(scale(t(heat)))
# Annotation for samples
annotation_col <- data.frame(Condition = c("RMC", "RMC","RMC","DMSO","DMSO","DMSO"))
# Annotation colors
ann_colors <- list(
  Condition = c(
    RMC = "red",
    DMSO  = "blue"
  )
)
#pdf("/Users/mqudratullah/Desktop/R/EMT.pdf",width = 10,height = 12)
pheatmap(
  mat_scaled,
  scale = "row",
  name = "zscore",
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  color = colorRampPalette(
    c("blue", "white", "red")
  )(100),
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  fontsize_row = 8,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  main = "RMC vs DMSO"
)
#dev.off()
```
